purpose: Teach: 売り込み/給水/消火/手掛け/綴る/祭祀/即位/レポーター

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規開拓の、本気で、絶対、売り込み、絶対、お話、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward on the new client development pitch with everything we've got.
lines.style: Brisk, forward momentum. Clipped consonants on the opening. Light pressure on 'move forward.' Collaborative energy, not commanding—she's inviting him in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員食堂の、本気for、絶対、給水、絶対、設備、絶対、更新、絶対、計画しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to update the staff cafeteria's water supply system, and I appreciate your support on that.
lines.style: Cooperative, steady. Mid-level energy. Acknowledges the prior direction with a soft nod in the voice. Sincere gratitude at the end—not performative, genuinely warm.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 倉庫の、本気で、絶対、消火、絶対、設備、絶対、最新化、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's also prioritize modernizing the fire safety equipment in the warehouse.
lines.style: Clear directive, but collaborative in tone. Measured pace. Slight lift on 'also'—adding to the list without weight. Grounded, practical energy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社が、本気で、絶対、手掛けて、絶対、いる、絶対、新サービス、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The new service we've been developing has been getting excellent feedback, and I'm grateful for your leadership on it.
lines.style: Update delivery with genuine warmth underneath. Steady, competent. Slight lift of pride when mentioning the positive reception. The gratitude feels earned, not scripted.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社史を、本気で、絶対、綴る、絶対、プロジェクト、絶対、始めましょうか
lines.en: Should we start a project to document the company's history?
lines.style: Reflective, inviting. Slower pace than the directives. Opening softens—she's genuinely asking, not deciding for him. Slight trailing lift on the question, like she's testing the idea.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業の、本気で、絶対、祭祀、絶対、当社、絶対、毎年、絶対、行っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We hold our founding ceremony every year, and I'm grateful we're continuing that tradition.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Slower than before—the tone carries respect for the tradition being mentioned. Sincere warmth at the close. No rush.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の新人社長の、本気で、絶対、即位、絶対、お祝い、絶対、ご準備、絶対、お願いします
lines.en: Could you help us prepare a celebration for the new industry president's inauguration?
lines.style: Polite direction with genuine request underneath. Measured, formal register. Slight courtesy softness on 'could you help'—this matters, and she's asking sincerely.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、レポーター、絶対、養成、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're developing our internal reporter training program, and I appreciate your involvement in that effort.
lines.style: Closing statement with steady competence. Warm but professional. Slight reflection—acknowledging the work being done. Genuine gratitude, delivered without fuss. Lands with quiet finality.
